title: tigridia pavonia
intro: Tigridia pavonia, commonly known as Mexican shellflower or tiger flower, is a plant species belonging to the family Iridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Tigridia pavonia include its potential to exhibit sedative, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Tigridia pavonia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
